episode_title: You Don't Need Perfect Conditions to Start | The Purpose Rules: Mindset, Pt. 3
question: What are the five stages of the Purpose Rules framework for financial transformation?
transcript_excerpt: Stage one is your goals—pick your top three, not ten, because when everything is a priority, nothing is. Stage two is your budget, not a punishment but a map to find the holes in the boat where money slips away monthly. Stage three is your net worth, what you own minus what you owe, as your starting point. Stage four is protection through life insurance and living benefits if you get sick or hurt and cannot work. Stage five is the savings rule—aim to save 20 percent of what comes in and at minimum 10 percent, and learn to live off the rest.

episode_title: You Don't Need Perfect Conditions to Start | The Purpose Rules: Mindset, Pt. 3
question: Why do people stay financially stuck even when they understand money principles?
transcript_excerpt: It is nearly impossible to get out of our own way without guidance, mentorship, and coaching. Support can start small—a book, a podcast, a workshop, or a mastermind group—to show that a better life with money is not just a dream. Most people who try without support end up falling backwards because they are trying to carry it all by themselves. Asking for help is the first sign that you are serious about getting out, not a sign that you have failed.

episode_title: You Don't Need Perfect Conditions to Start | The Purpose Rules: Mindset, Pt. 3
question: What is the relationship between staying stuck in uncomfortable situations and addiction?
transcript_excerpt: Staying stuck can become its own kind of addiction. Addictions come in many forms beyond alcohol and drugs—sometimes it is being stuck in the uncomfortable because the uncomfortable is familiar. The alternative asks us to acknowledge where we really are, accept our circumstances, and work through them without knowing exactly how long it will take, which feels scarier to many than staying put and keeping the mask on while the hamster wheel keeps turning.

episode_title: You Don't Need Perfect Conditions to Start | The Purpose Rules: Mindset, Pt. 3
question: How did Trevor and Karen apply the Purpose Rules without waiting for perfect conditions?
transcript_excerpt: Trevor had a good job but felt money was always tight due to his belief that you have to look successful to be successful. He did not wait for a raise but started with what he had, picked his top three goals, built a budget, freed up a few hundred dollars monthly by choosing a good used truck and keeping his phone until it quit, and applied that money toward his goals. Karen earned well but felt guilty spending on herself due to inherited beliefs. Her first step was not a two-week trip but a weekend away, planned, budgeted, and guilt-free, proving she could enjoy her earned life without wrongdoing.

episode_title: You Don't Need Perfect Conditions to Start | The Purpose Rules: Mindset, Pt. 3
question: What are the five stages of quiet desperation that indicate financial stress?
transcript_excerpt: Stage one is avoiding looking at your numbers. Stage two is Sunday night dread becoming part of the week. Stage three is living in when-then thinking—when I get the raise, then I will deal with it. Stage four is spending to feel better and then feeling worse. Stage five is stopping planning anything fun. These stages, combined with the underlying beliefs inherited from childhood and family, create a cycle where people wear a mask and nobody sees what is really going on underneath.
